question: Does VS Code render TreeItem.iconPath (a file Uri) as a CSS mask or as a background-image? The answer decides whether the operator's four status SVGs need {light, dark} variants or a single currentColor asset.
verdict: BACKGROUND-IMAGE — the SVG paints as authored, so `currentColor` cannot inherit the workbench foreground; a {light, dark} pair is the selected solution, not the only workable one
